title: Inspect and render an explicit projective transform
summary: Validate a strict four-corner ProjectiveSpec or render a bounded local raster through it without inferring planes, corners, or camera geometry.

operations.title: Inspect projective geometry
operations.description: Validate and solve one caller-supplied ProjectiveSpec, preserving strict TL, TR, BR, BL corner order and returning compact geometry evidence.

errors.description: The request or ProjectiveSpec shape is invalid.
The explicit quad is self-intersecting, concave, mirrored, degenerate, singular, or crosses the projective horizon.

operations.title: Render projective raster
operations.description: Inverse-map a bounded local PNG, JPEG, or WebP through an explicit ProjectiveSpec and atomically publish a PNG. This operation does not detect a plane or choose corners.
